2608.12751.title: SynAct: A Reasoning-Acting Large Language Model Agent for Adaptive Synthesis Optimization
2608.12751.paper_summary: Logic synthesis transforms RTL designs into gate-level netlists, where PPA results are highly sensitive to the choice of optimization commands, making synthesis tuning both high-dimensional and expensive. Previous approaches fall into two categories: automated methods, which perform black-box search over fixed action spaces with limited decision-level interpretability, and LLM-based methods, which typically generate static scripts upfront and cannot adapt to evolving circuit states. We present SynAct, an adaptive closed-loop LLM reasoning--acting agent that iteratively diagnoses live synthesis reports and reasons over the current circuit state, retrieved tool knowledge, and historical optimization experience to issue targeted commands. SynAct focuses on improving timing, particularly worst negative slack (WNS), while maintaining balanced area and power trade-offs. Experiments on a commercial synthesis tool across 14 designs show that SynAct reduces average WNS to 27% of that from bootstrap synthesis.
2608.12751.paper_summary_zh: 邏輯合成將 RTL 設計轉換為閘級網路清單，其中 PPA 結果對優化命令的選擇高度敏感，使得合成調整既高維又昂貴。以往的方法可分為兩類：自動化方法，這些方法在固定的行動空間上進行黑箱搜索，具有有限的決策級可解釋性，以及基於 LLM 的方法，這些方法通常事先生成靜態腳本，無法適應不斷變化的電路狀態。我們提出了 SynAct，一種自適應閉環 LLM 推理-行動代理，它迭代診斷即時合成報告，並根據當前電路狀態、檢索的工具知識和歷史優化經驗進行推理，以發出針對性的命令。SynAct 專注於改善時序，特別是最壞負鬆弛（WNS），同時保持面積和功耗的平衡權衡。在 14 個設計上對商業合成工具的實驗顯示，SynAct 將平均 WNS 降至引導合成的 27%。
